q1.sampleAnswer:
From: Manon
Subject: School music project
Hi,
You’ve done a great job! Thanks a lot for borrow those books from library.
I agree totally with you. That is exactly what I think! And I think we can write about Beethovan, because he had composed many classical music. Do you agree with it?
Well, I’m sorry to tell you that my laptop has some problems and I have already sent it to a computer shop to repair it. Maybe I can get back on next Monday. So, I think we need to do our project using library’s computer.
I think we could ask Mr. Chai, because he has lots of interests in classical music.
See you soon,
Manon

keyPoints.descZh: 内容：回应邮件中的四条笔记：①感谢 Pat 从图书馆借来书（Thanks!）；②告诉 Pat 自己对写古典音乐的看法（Tell Pat）；③说明不能用自己的笔记本电脑及原因（Sorry, but …）；④建议请谁来检查作业（Suggest someone）
交际效果：文体和语气符合任务要求，能清楚表达观点并吸引读者
条理性：结构清晰、衔接连贯，使用多种连接词和衔接手段
语言：词汇和语法结构的丰富性与准确性

anchors.noteZh: 内容5/交际效果4/条理性3/语言3。四个要点都已回应；非正式语气友好，开头结尾得体（Thank you so much, See you soon），但个别地方重复（we should do the music we interest. Hence, we should do the music we like）；行文连贯，用指代和时间从句衔接，但缺少基础连接词；能运用多种时态和与音乐相关的日常词汇（borrowed, Jazz, assignment, musical family），有 for borrowed, the music we interest, laptop have been stolen, suggest to let Irene to check 等错误，但不影响理解。

q1.explanationZh: 满分邮件要逐一回应四条笔记：感谢 Pat 借书、说出对写古典音乐的看法、解释为什么不能用自己的笔记本电脑、建议请谁检查作业；语气友好，分段清楚，约 100 词。

q2.sampleAnswer: I’m Chloé and when I’m not at school, I’m usually to be found at home, doing homework or playing video games. But in the weekend, I really like to go outside with some friends. We usually hang out on the playground of their elementary school. We don’t really do much besides talking and listening to some music. When it’s too cold to go outside, we go to my house, because I have netflix, and watch a movie with some chips. I also ride horse, but because of my lungs, I can’t go when it’s really cold, but now that it’s getting warmer, I can go horseriding again! I used to go to a club, but it was getting boring there. I like hanging out with friends because it’s more fun then watching a movie alone.

keyPoints.descZh: 内容：文章回答两个问题：①不上学时，自己和朋友更喜欢在家放松，还是参加俱乐部、体育课等有组织的活动；②说明原因（Why?）

条理性：结构清晰、衔接连贯，使用多种连接词和衔接手段
语言：词汇和语法结构的丰富性与准确性

anchors.noteZh: 内容5/交际效果4/条理性4/语言4。充分说明了自己喜欢怎样度过空余时间及原因；包含大量个人信息，风格吸引读者（I’m Chloé, I really like, I can’t go when it’s really cold）；虽然只有一段，但用 and when, But, besides, because 等连接词和指代衔接，条理清楚；日常词汇恰当（video games, hang out, playground），能用 I’m usually to be found…, now that…, I used to… but… 等多种结构，只有 in the weekend, on the playground 等介词小错误。

anchors.response:
When me and my friend are not at school, I like to hang out with a friend and relax. But when it’s summer, we sometimes go to the pool. I also like to sport. I like lots of sports like running, riding my bike, soccer and a lot more, but most of the time I take dance classes. It helps you relax after a tiring week!
When I’m too tired to play sports, I just relax at home while I’m listening to music, mostly listen to pop. Sometimes I also watch a movie and rest on the couch, or even take a nap!
anchors.noteZh: 内容5/交际效果3/条理性3/语言3。说明了喜欢怎样度过空余时间及原因；用中立的风格表达简单清楚的观点（I like to, When I’m too tired to play sports）；用 But when, also, and, while 等基础连接词，但名词重复、缺少指代，如 me and my friend … with a friend，读者分不清是不是同一个朋友；与话题相关的日常词汇恰当（pool, dance, couch, nap），能熟练使用简单句和并列句，有 I also like to sport, mostly listen to pop 等错误，但不妨碍理解。

q2.explanationZh: 满分文章要明确回答更喜欢在家放松还是参加有组织的活动，并用具体例子说明原因；语气吸引读者，有开头和结尾，约 100 词。

q3.sampleAnswer: Mallory opened the door and ran down the street. He already was late for his first period. All the streets were empty. His steps were fast and loud, and his breath was shaking. ‘I really need to exercise more’ he thought. The running turned into walking, and...he stopped. Wait, where was he? This is not his little town! He turned around himself twice. Yes, this definetly wasn’t his town. Buildings were big and modern, and cars were driving really fast. His bag dropped of his shoulder, while he was searching for a bus stop. He didn’t know where he was, or how he got here, but he needed to go back to home. He started running, faster and faster, and...boom! He fell out of his bed. So was it really a dream? Everything felt real.

keyPoints.descZh: 内容：故事以给定的句子开头（Mallory 打开门，沿着街道跑去），情节与开头句相关、合乎逻辑，有清楚的开头、发展和结尾
交际效果：文体和语气符合任务要求，能清楚表达观点并吸引读者
条理性：结构清晰、衔接连贯，使用多种连接词和衔接手段
语言：词汇和语法结构的丰富性与准确性

anchors.response: Mallory opened the door and ran down the street. She was late for school. When she was in her garden, she saw an empty bus stop. She had to walk to school. When she was walking, she saw a man on the street. He was lost. Mallory likes to help people, so she ran to him. He told her, that he can’t remember his name and he doesn’t know where he is. The girl knows that she is late to school but she decided to help him. Mallory was walking with him from house to house, but nobody knows him. Finally, the door opened an old woman. She told the girl, that this man is her husband. She was worried about him. When Mallory came to school, she ran to class to tell the teacher about this situation. He wasn’t angry. Mallory promised that she won’t be late from now.
anchors.noteZh: 内容5/交际效果4/条理性4/语言3。故事承接开头句合乎逻辑地展开，有开头、中间和结尾；用间接引语（He told her, that…）、引入新人物和细节吸引读者；事件顺序清楚，用 When, Finally 衔接；日常词汇有些重复，句子大多很短，只用简单结构，Mallory was walking … but nobody knows him 等句时态混乱，但不影响整体理解。

q3.explanationZh: 满分故事要用给定句开头，交代 Mallory 为什么跑、接下来发生了什么，情节连贯，有清楚的结尾；叙事时态准确，有描写和细节，约 100 词。
